nodes.label: UO Domain Ontology
nodes.comment: Canonical schema for Alex knowledge graph.

nodes.label: abstract
nodes.comment: True when the class is an abstract name — never used as a type: value in frontmatter or in text; concrete subclasses carry the user-facing names.

nodes.label: type name
nodes.comment: The exact type: token and fileClass name for this class, when it differs from the label (e.g. Ontology Entity → OntologyEntity).

nodes.label: field name
nodes.comment: The exact Obsidian frontmatter key this property is stored as, when it differs from the snake_cased label (e.g. hasAxis → axis, alternateName → alternateName).

nodes.label: Entity
nodes.comment: Abstract base class for all named things in the graph.

nodes.label: Information Content Entity
nodes.comment: An information artifact that is about something — notes, messages, documents, transcripts, recordings. (IAO Information Content Entity; BFO Generically Dependent Continuant.)

nodes.label: Ontology
nodes.comment: A formal, named namespace of terms (classes and properties) with a canonical IRI prefix.

nodes.label: Ontology Entity
nodes.comment: A class term defined within a specific Ontology — e.g. Thread, Role, prov:Entity, skos:Concept. Attributes (e.g. phone, participants) are uo:Property, not OntologyEntity. References its parent Ontology via inOntology.

nodes.label: Property
nodes.comment: An attribute or relation defined within an Ontology — e.g. phone, participants, up. Distinct from OntologyEntity (class terms).

nodes.label: Thread
nodes.comment: Abstract name for a connected sequence of work items — like up/down/prev/next for edges, the abstract name is never used in text or frontmatter; renderings are Project, Epic, Task, Idea, sites visited, etc. Threads are semantic, more like annotations; contrast uo:Activity, which is grounded in real data.

nodes.label: Chain
nodes.comment: Deprecated synonym of Thread (deprecated 2026-07-29).

nodes.label: Activity
nodes.comment: A timespan or event on the timeline, based on real data (LLM logs, chats, etc.). Overlaps with Thread but not exactly: Threads are semantic annotations; Activities are real-data timespans.

nodes.label: Scheme
nodes.comment: A controlled vocabulary: the set of allowed values for a typed frontmatter field. Members are SKOS Concepts that point back via inScheme.

nodes.label: Dimension
nodes.comment: A classifier value attached to work items — the value of a dimension field (e.g. Xsolla, AI). A SKOS concept; the vocabularies that hold dimension values are Schemes (skos:ConceptScheme — Axis, Theme, Grouping).

nodes.label: Concept
nodes.comment: An abstract topic, framework, or domain (e.g. Ontology, Compliance).

nodes.label: Platform
nodes.comment: A tool, SaaS service, or piece of infrastructure.

nodes.label: Person
nodes.comment: A human individual.

nodes.label: Org
nodes.comment: An organisation (company, team, legal entity).

nodes.label: Place
nodes.comment: A geographic location (city, office, region).

nodes.label: Role
nodes.comment: A role someone plays inside an org or project.

nodes.label: Project
nodes.comment: An initiative with status, owner, and one or more axes. (BFO Process; PROV Activity via Thread.)

nodes.label: Ongoing
nodes.comment: Deprecated page schema; ongoing-ness is lifecycle/status, not schema.

nodes.label: Project File
nodes.comment: A piece of textual content (notes, sections, attachments) belonging to a Project, Epic, Idea, or Task page, co-located with its parent file.

nodes.label: Axis
nodes.comment: Controlled vocabulary of axis dimension-values.

nodes.label: Karelin
nodes.comment: Personal/meta axis — Alex Karelin's own domain and cross-cutting work.

nodes.label: Grouping
nodes.comment: Controlled vocabulary of grouping dimension-values (top-level domains projects sit under).

nodes.label: Process
nodes.comment: A node in a work-lifecycle scheme — phases (Start, Scope, Pre-production, Production, Result) and the entities recognised within them.

nodes.label: Source
nodes.comment: Provenance of an entity record — how it was captured into the graph. Closed vocabulary (backfilled from KG source: field).

nodes.label: Status
nodes.comment: Lifecycle status of a project. Closed vocabulary (backfilled from KG status: field).

nodes.label: Theme
nodes.comment: Controlled vocabulary of theme dimension-values.

literals.value: Last three Voice Interactive memory checkpoints

Structured from the available Voice Interactive memory context; not a verbatim transcript. Migrated from the urn:alex:kg: namespace into UO; dictation artefacts resolved (dictated forms noted in comments).
A dictated statement associated person with organization and said that association was not required; its intended predicate or cardinality was not clear enough to formalize.

nodes.label: Maintained
nodes.comment: A lifecycle state for a created or curated information content entity.

nodes.label: tags
nodes.comment: Free-text keyword tags.

nodes.label: description
nodes.comment: Free-text description of the entity. On ontology term pages it mirrors the term's rdfs:comment and round-trips via sync.

nodes.label: status
nodes.comment: Lifecycle status. Constrained vocabulary (uo:Status).

nodes.label: up
nodes.comment: Hierarchical parent: the broader entity this one sits under.

nodes.label: down
nodes.comment: Hierarchical child: inverse of up.

nodes.label: prev
nodes.comment: Previous item in a sequence of entities.

nodes.label: next
nodes.comment: Next item in a sequence of entities: inverse of prev.

nodes.label: has axis
nodes.comment: Multi-valued. The first item is the primary axis.

nodes.label: has grouping
nodes.comment: Grouping (top-level domain) this entity belongs to. Constrained vocabulary.
